features: Viability bounds (solvency floor as hard limit)
Evidence-gated setpoint (mission/brand moves on real signal)

unmet_needs: a business that stays coherent over years, not days
missing_features: replay of why a move happened
underserved_segments: founders already burned by autonomous operators

genuine_differences: Objective is time-in-game (viability margin), not throughput or revenue
Revenue is a regulated output; solvency is a bound
Every claim labelled; every move replayable
differentiation.ownable_territory: Living continuity — the operator that keeps a business in the game (infinite-game physics, Carse lineage)
differentiation.unfair_advantage: A formal doctrine (viability kernel, allostasis, Red Queen) already encoded as fail-closed contracts across a working organ stack, plus free Genesis as the top of funnel

data.positioning_statement: For solo founders and small studios burned by agents that 'run your company' into the ground, Cambium is the always-on venture operator that keeps the business inside its viability bounds. Unlike Polsia or NanoCorp, which maximize task throughput, Cambium treats solvency as a hard limit, gates every irreversible move, and logs every decision so it can be replayed.
